title: 12 Best Craft Beer in Boston
description: Explore Boston's thriving craft beer scene! Discover the top breweries, taprooms, and gastropubs for the best IPAs, stouts, and unique brews. Your ultimate guide.

places.name: Trillium Brewing Company (Fort Point)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their rotating Double IPAs, especially 'DDH Congress Street IPA' or a seasonal sour.

places.name: Harpoon Brewery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic 'Harpoon IPA' with one of their famous giant soft pretzels and a side of beer cheese.

places.name: Lamplighter Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try 'Group Hug' (Hazy IPA) or one of their experimental pastry stouts. Don't miss their coffee if you're there early.

places.name: Samuel Adams Brewery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy the complimentary tasting flight on the tour, which often includes limited-release beers alongside their iconic 'Boston Lager'.

places.name: Night Shift Brewing (Lovejoy Wharf)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try 'Whirlpool' (New England Pale Ale) or one of their 'Weirding Way' experimental sours. Their pizza is also surprisingly good.

places.name: Cambridge Brewing Company
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their flagship 'Cambridge Amber' or a seasonal brew like their 'Arquebus' (Barrel-Aged Stout), complemented by their famous mussels.

places.name: Dorchester Brewing Company
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try 'Neponset Gold' (Kölsch) or 'V-Line IPA'. Their brick oven pizza is a must-have pairing.

places.name: Aeronaut Brewing Company
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their flagship 'Aeronaut IPA' or 'Robot Crush' (Pilsner). Check for current food pop-ups for pairing options.

places.name: Democracy Brewing
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try 'Consensus' (Kolsch) or 'Workforce IPA'. Their 'Democracy Burger' is a popular choice for food.

places.name: Castle Island Brewing Co. (South Boston)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order 'Keeper' (IPA) or 'Couch' (Session IPA). Definitely get a fresh-baked pizza to go with your beer.

places.name: Brato Brewhouse + Kitchen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pair any of their house-brewed beers (like a seasonal lager or IPA) with their ever-changing 'Sausage of the Week' or the 'Smash Burger'.

places.name: Lord Hobo Brewing Co. (Cambridge)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order You absolutely have to try 'Boom Sauce' (New England IPA). Pair it with their delicious, greasy fries.
